items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: Did you make any records with anybody besides Celestine?

ctx.x: Mm-hmm . So, when Celestine made a record, every man playing on the record was his name was on
the record. Did you make any records with anybody besides Celestine?

No, I didn't make them, but I had a chance to make them, but I wouldn't have gone with them. The reason why I did make them, making records ain't easy enough. Oh, that ain't easy, yeah. I mean, everything's got to be right down the top. In that studio, you'd be shut up in that room so hot. And you don't talk, you won't wait by sign. Everything is signed with. Because they're basically something that comes out on the record. And then sometimes they'll make one number. You've got three or four records, four or five…
